pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.summary: How we collect, use and protect your personal information when you shop with AURAQ.
pages.content:
AURAQ ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you visit our website or place an order, how we use it, and the choices you have.

## Information we collect

**Information you give us.** When you create an account, place an order, subscribe to our newsletter or contact customer care, we collect details such as your name, email address, phone number, shipping and billing addresses, and your order history.

**Payment information.** Card and wallet payments are processed by our payment partners. We never store full card numbers on our servers. For cash on delivery and bank transfer orders we only record the payment method and status.

**Information collected automatically.** We collect technical information such as your device type, browser, pages viewed and referring website. We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and to remember the contents of your bag.

## How we use your information

- To process, ship and support your orders, including sending order and delivery updates.
- To manage your account, wishlist, saved addresses and reviews.
- To send marketing emails when you have opted in. Every email includes an unsubscribe link.
- To prevent fraud, secure our website and comply with legal obligations.
- To understand how our website is used so we can improve it.

## Sharing your information

We share information only with partners who help us operate our business — courier companies, payment providers, email and hosting services — and only to the extent they need to perform their service. We do not sell your personal information.

## Data retention

We keep order records for as long as required for accounting and tax purposes. Account information is kept while your account is active. You can ask us to delete your account at any time.

## Your rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by writing to care@auraq.pk. You can update most account details yourself from your account dashboard.

## Security

We use industry-standard encryption (HTTPS) and access controls to protect your data. Access to customer information is limited to staff who need it to fulfil orders.

## Children

Our website is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their information.

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.

## Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to care@auraq.pk or AURAQ Customer Care, 14-C MM Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan.

pages.title: Return & Exchange Policy
pages.summary: Exchanges within 14 days, store credit and how to start a return.
pages.content:
We want you to love what you ordered. If something isn't right, we're happy to help.

## Exchange window

Ready-to-wear, luxury pret and formal pieces can be exchanged for a different size or style within **14 days** of delivery. Unstitched fabric can be exchanged within **7 days** of delivery provided it has not been cut.

## Eligibility

To be eligible, items must be:

- Unworn, unwashed and unaltered, with all original tags attached.
- Returned in the original packaging with the invoice or order number.
- Free from perfume, makeup or stains.

The following cannot be exchanged or returned:

- Items purchased on final sale or with a "Final Sale" label.
- Customised, altered or made-to-measure pieces.
- Jewellery, accessories and gift cards.

## Refunds

Exchanges are our preferred resolution. Where an exchange is not possible, we issue **store credit** valid for six months. Cash refunds are offered only for items that arrive damaged, defective or incorrect.

## Damaged or incorrect items

If your order arrives damaged or you received the wrong item, please contact us within **48 hours** of delivery with photographs of the item and packaging. We will arrange a free collection and replacement.

## How to start an exchange

1. Email care@auraq.pk or message us on WhatsApp with your order number and the items you'd like to exchange.
2. Our team will confirm eligibility and share the return address.
3. Pack the items securely with the invoice and send them back. Return shipping is the customer's responsibility unless the item was faulty.
4. Once received and inspected, your exchange or store credit is processed within 5–7 working days.

## International orders

International orders can be exchanged within 14 days of delivery. Return shipping and any duties are paid by the customer.

pages.title: Shipping Policy
pages.summary: Delivery times, charges and tracking for orders within Pakistan and worldwide.
pages.content:
## Processing time

Orders are processed within **1–2 working days**. Orders placed after 3pm, on Sundays or on public holidays are processed the next working day. During sale periods and festive launches, processing may take slightly longer.

## Delivery within Pakistan

| Method | Delivery time | Charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Delivery | 3–5 working days | Rs. 250, complimentary over Rs. 5,000 |
| Express Delivery | 1–2 working days (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad) | Rs. 650 |

Delivery times for remote areas may be longer. Cash on delivery is available nationwide.

## International shipping

We ship to the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada and Australia. International orders are delivered within **7–12 working days** via tracked courier. Shipping is complimentary on orders above Rs. 60,000.

International customers are responsible for any import duties or taxes charged by their country's customs authority.

## Tracking your order

Once your order is dispatched you will receive an email with your tracking number. You can also check your order status from your account or on our Track Order page.

## Failed delivery

Our courier will attempt delivery twice. If delivery is unsuccessful, the parcel is returned to us and we will contact you to arrange re-delivery. Re-delivery charges may apply.

## Address changes

Please contact us as soon as possible if you need to change your delivery address. We can only update addresses before your order has been dispatched.

pages.title: Cancellation Policy
pages.summary: When and how an order can be cancelled.
pages.content:
## Cancelling your order

You can cancel your order free of charge **before it has been dispatched**. To cancel, email care@auraq.pk or contact customer care with your order number as soon as possible.

Once an order has been dispatched it can no longer be cancelled. You may instead request an exchange once it is delivered, in line with our Return & Exchange Policy.

## Prepaid orders

If you paid online or by bank transfer, cancelled orders are refunded to the original payment method within **7–10 working days**. Your bank may take additional time to reflect the refund.

## Cash on delivery

Repeatedly refusing cash-on-delivery parcels may result in cash on delivery being disabled for your account.

## Cancellations by AURAQ

We may cancel an order if an item is out of stock, if there is a pricing error, or if we are unable to verify the order. If this happens we will notify you immediately and refund any payment in full.

## Products and pricing

## Reviews and content

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.summary: Answers to common questions about orders, sizing, delivery and exchanges.
pages.content:
## Orders & payment

**Which payment methods do you accept?**
Cash on delivery and bank transfer are available nationwide. Additional online payment methods are shown at checkout when available.

**Can I change my order after placing it?**
Contact us as soon as possible. We can amend orders that have not yet been dispatched.

## Sizing

**How do I choose my size?**
Each product page includes a size guide with measurements in inches, and our full [Size Guide](/size-guide) explains how to measure. If you are between sizes, we recommend the larger size for a relaxed fit.

**Are your colours accurate?**
We photograph every piece in natural light. Slight variations can occur due to screen settings and hand-dyeing.

## Delivery

**How long does delivery take?**
Standard delivery takes 3–5 working days within Pakistan; express delivery takes 1–2 working days in major cities. International orders take 7–12 working days.

**How can I track my order?**
Use the Track Order page with your order number and email address, or sign in to view your order history.

## Exchanges

**What is your exchange policy?**
Unworn items with tags attached can be exchanged within 14 days of delivery. Please see our Return & Exchange Policy for details.

pages.content:
## Customer care

- **Phone:** +92 42 111 287 727
- **WhatsApp:** +92 300 0287 727
- **Email:** care@auraq.pk

Our team is available **Monday to Saturday, 10am – 8pm PKT**. We aim to respond to every email within one working day.

## Flagship store

14-C MM Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
Open daily, 11am – 10pm

## Wholesale & press

For wholesale enquiries and press requests, email hello@auraq.pk.

reviews.title: Even more beautiful in person
reviews.content: The embroidery on the neckline is so finely done and the organza dupatta drapes perfectly. Wore it to my sister’s mehndi and was asked about it all evening.

reviews.title: True to size, lovely fabric
reviews.content: I was unsure about ordering formals online but the size guide was accurate. Delivered to Karachi in two days and beautifully packed.

reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.content: Ordered to London for Eid. The colour is exactly as pictured, and the exchange process for a different size was effortless.

reviews.title: Elegant and comfortable
reviews.content: Beautiful raw silk with a soft lining. The trouser runs slightly long for me but the shirt fits perfectly.

reviews.title: My favourite purchase this year
reviews.content: The lavender is so soft and the handwork is exquisite. Compliments all night at a wedding dinner.

reviews.title: Perfect everyday suit
reviews.content: Breathable lawn and the print is gorgeous. Bought it on sale — great value for the quality.

reviews.title: Pretty colour
reviews.content: Lovely colour and very comfortable in the heat. Colour faded very slightly after a few washes in warm water, so wash cold.

reviews.title: Chic co-ord set
reviews.content: Modern cut and the sand colour is very versatile. I wear the trousers with other kurtas too.

reviews.title: Great fit
reviews.content: Fits beautifully and the cotton net is lighter than I expected. Perfect for summer dinners.

reviews.title: Festive perfection
reviews.content: The gold border catches the light so beautifully. Packaging felt like a gift.

reviews.title: Lovely, slightly sheer
reviews.content: Gorgeous suit, the chiffon is a little sheer so I wore a slip underneath. Otherwise perfect.

reviews.title: Stunning formal
reviews.content: This kalidar is breathtaking. Heavy, rich fabric and the zardozi is hand finished. Wore it for my nikkah dinner.

reviews.title: Like a dream
reviews.content: The powder blue is so soft and elegant. Fits exactly to the size chart.

reviews.title: Best lawn of the season
reviews.content: Soft lawn that stitched beautifully. Sold out quickly for a reason!

reviews.title: Lovely print
reviews.content: Print is beautiful and the embroidered panel is a nice touch. Dupatta is slightly thin.

reviews.title: Fresh and pretty
reviews.content: The mint colour is beautiful in daylight. Comfortable for long family gatherings.

reviews.title: Bright summer shirt
reviews.content: Cheerful colour and easy to style with white trousers. Great on sale.

reviews.title: Wardrobe staple
reviews.content: Simple, beautifully finished shirt. Bought a second one for my mother.

reviews.title: Elegant kurta
reviews.content: Beautiful neckline and the cotton silk has a lovely sheen. Pairs perfectly with the Sitara sharara.

reviews.title: Gorgeous dupatta
reviews.content: Light organza with a delicate border — lifts any plain outfit.

reviews.title: Warm and graceful
reviews.content: Karandi is warm without being heavy. The graphite colour is very chic.

reviews.title: Showstopper
reviews.content: The rose gold chiffon looks incredible in photos. Excellent stitching quality.

reviews.title: Pretty unstitched set
reviews.content: Lovely peach lawn, the embroidered panel is well placed. Tailor was impressed with the fabric.

reviews.title: Soft cambric
reviews.content: Comfortable for office wear and the dusty rose is very flattering.

reviews.title: The jacquard is beautiful
reviews.content: The weave has a lovely tone-on-tone motif that looks far more expensive than it is. Wore it to a dholki and my aunts kept touching the fabric.

reviews.title: Lovely, runs a little roomy
reviews.content: Gorgeous colour against the ivory trouser. I usually wear a medium but could have gone down a size, so check the measurements first.

reviews.title: Bought a second one
reviews.content: Came back for another as a gift for my sister. The stitching is neat and the shirt has kept its shape after several washes.

reviews.title: Elegant for the price
reviews.content: Simple and graceful, and the jacquard has a subtle sheen in daylight. The trouser could be a touch longer.

reviews.title: Perfect summer two piece
reviews.content: The coral is so cheerful and the lawn is genuinely breathable — I wore it through a 40-degree day in Pindi without feeling sticky.

reviews.title: Pretty print
reviews.content: The print is crisp and the colour is true to the photos. Neckline embroidery is minimal, which I actually prefer for daily wear.

reviews.title: That pink!
reviews.content: The rani pink is rich without being loud, and the little mirrors at the neckline catch the light. Paired it with an ivory sharara for my cousin’s mayun.

reviews.title: Worth the splurge
reviews.content: The velvet is soft and substantial, and the zardozi is exquisite up close. I wore it for my walima and the colour photographed like a jewel.

reviews.title: Stitched beautifully
reviews.content: My tailor said it was a pleasure to work with. The lawn is fine and the shadow-work panel is placed perfectly. So cool to wear.

reviews.title: Lovely, slightly sheer
reviews.content: Gorgeous off-white with a soft sage dupatta. The shirt fabric is a little sheer so I had it lined. Took three days to reach Karachi.

reviews.title: Summer favourite
reviews.content: Light, elegant and it looks so put together. I get compliments every time I wear it to work.

reviews.title: Great cambric
reviews.content: Opaque, crisp cambric, no lining needed. The olive is earthy and very wearable. One star off because the printed border was narrower than I expected.

reviews.title: Dreamy organza
reviews.content: The ivory organza with the blush dupatta is so romantic. Ordered to London and it arrived within a week, packed in a box with tissue.

reviews.title: So many compliments
reviews.content: The gota work is fine and not at all scratchy. Wore it to a nikkah and three people asked where it was from.

reviews.title: Beautiful, delicate
reviews.content: Lovely suit. The organza needs careful handling — I steam it rather than iron. Sizing is accurate.

reviews.title: Instant festive outfit
reviews.content: Paired it with a plain ivory kurta and a gota dupatta for a mehndi and it looked like a full designer outfit. The waistband stayed comfortable all night.

reviews.title: Such an elegant violet
reviews.content: An unusual, grown-up shade of violet. The floor-length flare moves beautifully and the inside is finished as neatly as the outside.

reviews.title: Easy linen set
reviews.content: Relaxed fit and the steel blue is very chic. Linen creases, as expected, but that is part of the charm.

reviews.title: Travel favourite
reviews.content: Wore it on a flight to Islamabad and straight to lunch, and it still looked smart. The trousers sit comfortably all day.

reviews.title: Sold out for a reason
reviews.content: Soft lawn, a pretty sage print and it has washed well. I wish I had bought the peach one too.

reviews.title: Comfortable everyday wear
reviews.content: Light and comfortable, and the shirt length is just right. The colour is slightly more muted in person.

reviews.title: Sweet summer shirt
reviews.content: Simple, airy and the lilac shade is lovely. Good value in the sale.

reviews.title: Regal colour
reviews.content: The plum is stunning in person and the tilla work has real weight to it. I felt like royalty at my brother’s baraat.

reviews.title: Lovely chiffon set
reviews.content: The sequin panel is beautiful and the chiffon is good quality. Make sure your tailor adds a lining because the shirt is sheer.

reviews.title: Wedding season staple
reviews.content: The teal with the gold dupatta is a perfect combination. The raw silk feels rich and didn’t crease after a long evening.

reviews.title: Exactly as pictured
reviews.content: Colour, embroidery and fit are exactly like the website. Very happy with this one.

reviews.title: Cheerful print
reviews.content: Mint and coral is such a happy combination. The lawn is soft; the trouser fabric is a little thinner than the shirt.

reviews.title: Pure elegance
reviews.content: The ivory chiffon is so graceful and the gold work is delicate rather than flashy. Wore it to a formal dinner and felt wonderful.

reviews.title: Beautiful finishing
reviews.content: Even the inside seams are finished neatly. You can tell it was made with care.

reviews.title: Chic co-ord
reviews.content: Love the cut, and the tea pink is very flattering. The sleeves run slightly long on me.

reviews.title: My go-to kurta
reviews.content: The mustard is warm and pretty, and the cambric is crisp but soft. Gutted it has sold out — please restock!

reviews.title: Nice, but size up
reviews.content: Lovely colour and fabric, but the shoulders are a bit narrow. I would order one size up next time.

reviews.title: Fresh and light
reviews.content: The butter yellow is so pretty for summer and the print is very fine. My tailor loved working with it.

reviews.title: Good basic trouser
reviews.content: Straight cut, opaque and goes with everything. Would love more colours.

reviews.title: Breathtaking tissue
reviews.content: The gold tissue shimmers without looking brassy. Wore it for my sister’s mehndi night and it photographed beautifully.

reviews.title: Pretty tea pink
reviews.content: Soft lawn and neat embroidery. The dupatta is a little short for my liking but overall lovely.

reviews.title: Great find in the sale
reviews.content: Couldn’t believe the quality for the sale price — the peach chiffon is lined and the gold work is so fine.

reviews.title: Lovely flare
reviews.content: The floor-length flare is gorgeous. It’s a touch long for me at 5’2” so I had it hemmed.

reviews.title: Office favourite
reviews.content: Lavender cambric with a neat finish. Smart enough for work and comfortable through a long day.

reviews.title: Winter elegance
reviews.content: Warm karandi in a deep green — exactly what I wanted for winter weddings. It feels substantial and luxurious.

reviews.title: Beautiful colour
reviews.content: The rose shade is lovely and the chiffon drapes well. The embroidered border is the highlight.

reviews.title: Good everyday lawn
reviews.content: Pistachio is such a fresh colour and the lawn is soft. Value for money in the sale.

reviews.title: Timeless and regal
reviews.content: The deep teal and gold is timeless, and the lehnga has a beautiful weight and flare. It fit perfectly using the standard size chart.

reviews.title: Elegant ivory chiffon
reviews.content: Beautiful, delicate chiffon and the embroidered panels are generous. It does need a good tailor.

reviews.title: Lovely sky blue
reviews.content: Such a calming colour and the lawn is soft. Great price for the quality.

reviews.title: Champagne perfection
reviews.content: Elegant and light, and the organza held its shape all evening. Worth it for special occasions.

reviews.title: Easy summer suit
reviews.content: Pretty aqua shade and very comfortable. The shirt is slightly longer than I expected but I like it.

reviews.title: Comfortable linen co-ord
reviews.content: The lilac linen is soft and relaxed, and I wear the pieces separately too.

reviews.title: Flowy and fun
reviews.content: So much movement in this sharara and the waist is comfortable. Wore it with the Sitara kurta.
